com.colony_seasons.command.season.set.se: Serene Seasons is installed and decides the season, so nothing changed in the game (still day %s of its year). Use /season set for Serene Seasons.
com.colony_seasons.command.festival.forc: %s is on until you clear it.
There is no festival called %1$s. Festivals: %2$s
%s is switched off in the config.
com.colony_seasons.command.festival.clea: %s is no longer on by force.
No festival is on by force.
com.colony_seasons.command.decor.list.em: Colony %s has no decorations listed here.
com.colony_seasons.command.decor.list.no: No decorations are listed in this dimension.
com.colony_seasons.command.decor.remove: Colony %1$s: %2$s decorations removed, %3$s left alone because they were changed since, %4$s wait for their chunks to load.
com.colony_seasons.decor.no_room: The Decorator: there is not enough room at the festival marker for the tree.
com.colony_seasons.building.decorator.de: Home of the Decorator. All year he asks the warehouse for leaves, string, dye and lights and makes wreaths, garlands and strings of lights, so they are ready when a festival comes. A higher hut keeps more of each in stock.
colony_seasons:decorator.job.desc: Makes the colony's festival decorations from warehouse materials and keeps a stock of them at his workshop. When a festival's window opens he puts them up on the colony's buildings, and takes them down again afterwards.
colony_seasons:decorator.skills.desc: Creativity decides how quickly he puts the decorations up, Dexterity how quickly he makes each batch.
com.minecolonies.coremod.jei.decorator: Makes wreaths, garlands and strings of lights from warehouse materials and decorates the colony for its festivals.
com.minecolonies.coremod.setting.tooltip: On: the Decorator makes decorations whenever his stock is low, all year round. Off: he starts only when a festival's decoration window opens.
